_help: Hand fixes read by scripts/migrate_brackets.py. They only change how brackets are built;
matches.json and the database are never written. Teams match ignoring case and order.
Set "disabled": true to keep a fix without using it. Every run lists each fix as applied, disabled or not matched.
region: move one set to another region           {type, week, teams: [a, b], to}
dq:     disqualify a team in one set              {type, week, teams: [a, b], team, after_game, played_games: keep|void, reason}
winner: who won one game the DB has no result for {type, match_id, winner}
order:  the ladder order, first round first       {type, week, region, sets: [[a, b], [c, d]]}
